note: Switch "groundChoice" (test 5, docs/council/2026-11-27-units-ground-navy.md part 2, thread 47). Before a battle each general rolls a die, plus his skill (traits, at most 2), plus 1 in friendly land, plus 1 if his army has horse; the higher roll picks one of the place's ground cards. Inspired by CK3 (advantage from commander and terrain), Commands & Colors: Ancients (terrain caps horse) and EU4 (being caught crossing a river). Gela's river (13.109.5) and Syracuse's marsh (14.70.5) are history; the other cards and every number are invention.

cards.name: Open plain
cards.line: Horse +1; chariots cancel the other side's horse.

cards.name: Broken hills
cards.line: Horse and chariots give nothing; the side that knows the land +1.

cards.name: A pass
cards.line: Horse and chariots give nothing; the side that knows the land +1.

cards.source: Diodorus 13.109.5 (the river at Gela); Plutarch, Timoleon 27
cards.name: River and plain
cards.line: If the ground roll is won by 3 or more, the loser is caught half across the river: -2.

cards.source: Diodorus 14.70.5 (the marsh by the Great Harbour)
cards.name: Marsh by the harbour
cards.line: Horse gives nothing; a camp here sickens.

cards.name: The Epipolae heights
cards.line: The side that knows the land +1.

cards.name: The shore
cards.line: Ships at hand: a beaten army that reaches them loses fewer men.

cards.name: Lava fields
cards.line: Horse and chariots give nothing; the side that knows the land +1.

wishes.name: Seek open ground
wishes.text: If your general picks the ground, he looks for a plain (good for horse).

wishes.name: Seek broken ground
wishes.text: If your general picks the ground, he looks for hills or a pass (good for the side that knows the land).
